name: 911 Sketch Extractor
description: Extract PART SKETCH data from PDF packets to Excel with 17-column structure, combined weight, validation reports, and organized output folders
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the folder of part-sketch PDF packets ready - you pick it each run.
Make sure the PDFs are synced locally so they can be read.
how_it_works: The app reads each part sketch and extracts its data into a 17-column layout, consolidating weights and checking the values.
output: An Excel workbook with the 17-column sketch data and combined weight, a validation report, and organized output folders.
